immutability: Final CONTRACT_v1.json is written once after input manifest completion and before biological fitting or effect scoring. Preserve all frozen versions and prior negative studies.

scope.task: Conditional-on-author-filtered-public-cohort held-out-human-line model comparison for known POU5F1 CRISPRi
scope.estimand: Additional measured cells from an existing training human line versus the same number of cells from one specified cynomolgus line, evaluated on the completely held-out other human line.
scope.extra_human_interpretation: Additional disjoint cells from the SAME training line, not additional donors or cell lines.
scope.source_comparison: Both monkey lines are predefined separate source arms, each using one line. No selection of the better source after outcomes.

upstream_eligibility_limitation.evidence_status: Highly supported indirect export evidence: public GEO NTCguide ID sets exactly match author final RNA-effect-filtered controlguide lists, and author QCstep4 jointly uses both human lines; a direct GEOexport script trace was not recovered.
upstream_eligibility_limitation.consequence: The public cell cohort can reflect held-out-line RNA in upstream control-guide eligibility. This benchmark is conditional on that published cohort; no full-pipeline target-RNA-blind or fully prospective end-to-end QC claim.
upstream_eligibility_limitation.our_guarantee: Our downstream fitting, hyperparameter/checkpoint selection and source scale estimation exclude that fold held-out human line outcomes. Held-out NTC cells are available as query baselines; POU5F1 target cells are read for model scoring only after every prediction freezes.

limitations: Two human cell lines provide two biological target units. Three samplingseeds, eight GEMchannels, guides and cells do not increase biologicalN.
One known gene perturbation; no unseen-perturbation claim.
One experiment/chip exp2, multiple technical capturechannels; no new-screen generalization claim.
Original human HepG2 checkpoint preprocessing is incompletely recovered; this is an explicit new-assay contrast adaptation.
Native6546gene axis lacksPOU5F1; only downstream expression response is predicted.
Species-specific gRNA sequences and guide efficacy may differ. All published eligible guides are retained without selecting by RNAresponse.

Source cell budget matches extra-human measured-cell budget. Extra-human remains one existing human line, while monkey is another species/line; biological-information and monetary-cost equality are not asserted.
scope.prior_evidence: Retain negative rabbit/Lawlor results, old mouse/Parse/TG null-failing evidence, and exploratory G105 outputs without replacing them.

design.seed_interpretation: Prespecified cell-pool/sampling and training-order sensitivity; not independent biological replication. Initial pretrained weights and zero extension are identical.
design.eligibility: Retain deposited exp2 CellRanger-called POU5F1/NTC cells with exact author genotype demux and predetermined dominant-guide UMIs; no new RNA-expression/QC-threshold or guide-efficacy filtering.
design.guide_rule: Unique maximal dominantguideUMIs>10; allotherguidescombined<10percent and<1000UMIs; condition from POU5F1 versus NT guideidentity; do not infer guide identity from targetgene expression.
design.capture_identity: species|experiment_chip_lane|barcode. Eight lanes are distinct GEMcapturechannels; sequencing flow-cell lanes are merged into each capture CellRanger run. They are technical captures within one screen.
design.duplicate_audit: No duplicate full count vectors; recurrent bare barcodes across captures have different vectors. GEX and gRNA libraries/reference remaps are not extra cells.
design.canonical_POU5F1_guides: Four canonical POU5F1-targeting guides per species represented in both lines; retain all published guides. Three cells with other-species-prefixed POU5F1 dominantguide retain metadataflag and remain included, without expression-driven exclusion.

data.gene_rule: Exact unique author deposited human ENSG IDs in both measured axes and nativeState gene bridge. Macaque coordinates were already transferred by author Liftoff; do not apply second orthology conversion.
data.normalization: For each cell sum raw counts over all observed GENCODEv32 gene_type=protein_coding endogenous genes, exclude dCas9/cassette/guidefeatures; log1p(10000*raw_gene_count/coding_library_size), then select fixed6357modelgenes.
data.normalization_order: Complete observed coding universe before modelgene restriction; measuredmodelgenes remain in scoring even when not included in codingdenominator.
data.zero_coding_library_rule: Abort and report affected cell IDs; do not silently drop cells or change gene axis.
data.unsupported_channels: Identical bool6546 mask for everyarm; excluded inputcoords computationalzero only, no observed-zero target/scoring. Full pretrained latent paths retained.

normalized_axis.outside_coding_denominator_semantics: Output counts may include noncoding genes, expressed per coding-UMI library. Output axis is unchanged.

coding_reference.rule: only GTF feature gene; gene_type==protein_coding; exactstable ID, version suffix removed; preserve PAR_Ysuffix

pools.human_rule: For each trainingline/seed/condition, Hamilton largest-remainder allocation of384unique cells over capture×guide strata proportional to eligiblecounts; ties by fixedhash. Within stratum rankcells by fixedhash and selectquota. Divide selectedquota among base/extra/cal pools: each getsfloor(quota/3); assign remainingone-cell increments to currently smallest-total eligiblepool, withhash ties, ensuring eachpool128 and perstratummax-minus-min<=1.
pools.monkey_control_rule: For each monkeyline/seed Hamilton-select256NTC cells bycapture×guide; divide into realinput128 andnulltarget128 withsamebalanced2poolrule. Use identical realinputpool inA/A0.
pools.monkey_target_rule: For each monkeyline/seed Hamilton-select128POU5F1 cells bycapture×guide.
pools.population_disjointness: All base/extra/cal humanpools are pairwisedisjoint withinline/seed/condition; A0monkeyNTCinput/nulltarget disjoint. Cells can recur across predefined seeds, never counted as additional independentunits.
pools.test_population: All depositedeligiblecells of heldouthumanline, in bothconditions; no128cap.
pools.split_artifact: Metadata-only split tool writes explicitcellIDs,rowindices,stratumquotas,line/seed/condition/pool identities andhashmanifest before any fit.
pools.hash_algorithm: SHA256 of UTF8 pipe-delimited fields. Metadata split implementation and its SHA must be frozen in the split manifest before model fitting; it uses only capture,guide,cellID,line,condition,seed andintegercounts.

model.gene_heads: Retain all6546pretrained coordinates and full nativegene layers; no species-specific randomgenehead or slicing.
model.mode: eval with autograd enabled; deterministic twoforwards, dropoutoff

training.human_schedule: Samehumanbasecontrol/POUrowrank schedule in all6arms for samefold/seed/step
training.source_schedule: Same128-population rankposition schedule acrossHextra andbothmonkeysourcearms; sameactualNTCrows inA/A0; no withinpopulationreplacement.
training.random_initialization: Sameofficialweights andzeroextensions acrossarms;seeds determinepools/schedules; noextra modelseed search.
training.compute_scope: 200optimizerupdates matched; added armsincludeadditional sourceforward/backward and do not haveexactlyH-onlyFLOPs. Animal andextra-human additionalcellbudgets andsource-loss calls match.
training.failure_rule: Keepfailedfits/status; no drop/replacement ofline/seed/source, no budgetextension orscientificretuning aftertargetscores.

inference.cell_order: Ascending normalized input row index within the held-out line; capture/native-cell order is preserved, fixed by metadata-only splits. Identical control ordering in allarms andseeds.
inference.aggregation: Concatenatepredictions andcompute meanweight1perrealcell. NTCquerymean usesexactallsamecells acrossarms.

freeze.scope_of_exclusion: Fold-specific testline outcomes excludedfromthatfold fitting/calibration. Inoppositerotation thatline canserveastrainingline underfixedtwofoldCV; do notclaim itsRNAneverappearedanywhere.
freeze.metadata_hash_binding: Splitmanifest pins contractSHA,normalizedmanifestSHA,arraysSHA,splitJSONSHA andrunnercodeSHA beforeexpressionfitting. Normalizedarrayandrawinputbindings are embedded inthiscontract.
